sentences.text: The petitioners filed this petition U/s 166 of the Motor vehicles Act claiming compensation for the death of Chandrappa @ Chandra in a motor vehicle accident that occurred on 28.04.2023.
2. The case of the petitioners, in brief, is as follows:

On 28.04.2023 at about 11.15 p.m. the deceased Chandrappa was standing beside the road in order to  SCCH-17 3 MVC No. 2924-2023 cross the road on Bangalore- Hosur NH-44 road, in front of Cayer baby care board, at that time the driver of car bearing No. KA-05-MK-4232 came in a rash and negligent manner and dashed against the deceased.
Due to the impact, the deceased fell down and sustained grievous injuries and died on the spot.

At the time of accident, the deceased was working as HTV driver and earning Rs.30,000/- p.m. and he was contributing the same to his family maintenance, but due to untimely death of deceased the petitioners have suffered mentally and physically.
The petitioner No.1 is the wife and petitioner No.2 & 3 are the children of the deceased, have lost love and affection and care taker.

The respondents are the insurer and owner of the car bearing No. KA-05-MK-4232 are liable to pay compensation Shyamalamma vs Reliance Gen Ins Co Ltd on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/18177368/

sentences.text: In the accident cases, it is settled principle of law that "RES- IPSA LOQUITUR" which means the things speaks itself, is the standing principle to know the nature of the accident. Under this principle how the negligence has to be infer is considered.

In tort law, "RES- IPSA LOQUITUR" principle that allows petitioners to meet their burden of proof with under which a court can infer negligence from the very nature of an accident or injury in the absence of direct evidence on how any defendant  SCCH-17 12 MVC No. 2924-2023 behaved in the context of tort litigation.

On perusal of Ex.P3- contents of mahazar and rough sketch along with Ex.P4 IMV report wherein the damages of the vehicles involved in the accident is mentioned prima- facie shows the negligence on the part of the driver of car bearing No.KA-05-MK-4232.

If the driver of the car bearing No.
KA-05-MK-4232 was not driving his auto in rash and negligent manner there is no chances of dashing the deceased in the left side of the road.
Hence, by applying the said principle the negligence on the part of the driver of car bearing No. KA-05-MK-4232 is stands established.

Since the deceased left his wife and two children, it is considered that, there are three dependents of deceased, hence 1/3rd is to be deducted towards his personal expenses, then the total loss of dependency would be Rs.16,64,000/-
